faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the HP 15-da, 15-db, 15-dx, 15-cx, 15-cn and 15-cr series, which share the same chassis. Send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp to confirm your exact model.

faqs.question: What colours are available?
faqs.answer: This keyboard is available in black, white, or black with neon green accents — let us know which one matches your laptop when you order.

faqs.question: Is it backlit?
faqs.answer: Yes, this keyboard includes the backlight cable, matching the original.
